name: RLD paired controlled robustness v2

coordinate_noise.definition: independent zero-mean Gaussian XYZ noise with per-coordinate SD equal to level times the within-worm median pairwise Euclidean distance

missing_neurons.definition: retain max(2, round(N*(1-level))) rows using the manifest's deterministic source indices; slice every neuron-axis array identically

distractor_neurons.definition: append max(1, round(N*level)) valid population rows; XYZ sampled within the padded worm bounding box and activity sampled from a real row plus noise
distractor_neurons.input_contract: valid_xyz_mask=true; supervision masks=false; rows enter inference and are excluded only from GT scoring

frozen_components.template_or_atlas: selected or constructed from clean outer training only

metrics.common_query_cohort: the exact annotated/evaluable query rows stored in the corruption manifest; identical for every method; a query whose label is not representable by a method is retained and scored incorrect
metrics.top1: correct predictions divided by surviving queries in the common manifest cohort
metrics.top5: queries with the correct identity ranked at most five divided by surviving common-cohort queries; unrepresentable labels contribute zero
metrics.mrr: sum of reciprocal correct-label ranks divided by surviving common-cohort queries; unrepresentable labels contribute zero
metrics.coverage: surviving common-cohort queries divided by severity-zero common-cohort queries; therefore identical across methods for a fixed fold and draw
metrics.effective_top1: correct predictions divided by severity-zero common-cohort queries; equivalently top1 times coverage
metrics.retention: effective_top1 at severity divided by severity-zero top1
metrics.hungarian: correct assignments divided by surviving eligible queries under the same candidate vocabulary

aggregation: average corruption draws within each biological fold, then unweighted mean across five folds
uncertainty: 95% paired hierarchical bootstrap; resample biological folds, test animals within each sampled fold, and shared corruption-draw IDs; use the same resampling indices for every method
clean_gate: before common-cohort rescoring, each method/fold native severity-zero replay must match its saved current-grouped seed42 clean result: query counts and discrete hit-rate metrics use atol=1e-12; MRR alone uses atol=5e-8 to permit CPU/GPU floating-point reduction differences
old_main_table_note: The earlier 27.35% fDNC and 25.19% GeoTransformer summary used different fold families across methods. It is not the clean reference for this strictly paired experiment.
